one_line: Ancient sacred town on the Varada river, early Kadamba capital and temple landscape at the edge of the Western Ghats.

appearance.age_look: Looks like a lively late-teen anime boy embodying the town’s spirit, lean but sturdy build, about 17–18 years old.
appearance.face: Oval face with warm medium-brown complexion, straight nose, soft but alert dark eyes with slightly thick brows, a few faint freckles on the cheeks, default expression a calm, devotional half-smile that brightens when speaking of temples or the river.
appearance.hair: Deep black hair tied into a short high knot at the back (like a compact top-knot) with smooth, straight strands; front has neat, slightly uneven fringes framing the forehead; a simple thin ochre headband wraps around the knot, holding a small palm-leaf charm tucked at the side.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate early historic Deccan attire: a knee-length off-white cotton dhoti (veshti-style) wrapped snugly with a broad golden-ochre border, pleats falling slightly to the left; upper body modestly covered with a soft light-cream cotton uttariya (shawl) draped from the left shoulder across the chest and around the back to the right arm; over this, a sleeveless, slightly fitted dull-red cotton angavastra-like vest that ends just above the hip, edged with thin dark-brown piping; on the waist a narrow dark-green cloth belt (patka) knotted at the side with short tassels; simple leather sandals on the feet; ornaments limited to a single thin copper torque around the neck, a pair of small round copper ear-studs, and a plain black-thread wrist cord, all reflecting a modest but sacred-town resident rather than a royal figure.
appearance.signature: A narrow, well-worn palm-leaf manuscript roll bound with a dark-brown cord and tucked into his belt, often held reverently in his right hand as if showing inscriptions and temple lore.

ref_desc: Banavasi appears as a lean medium-brown teen boy with an oval face, black hair in a small top-knot with an ochre headband, wearing an off-white dhoti, cream shawl and dull-red vest with dark-green belt and copper ornaments, carrying a bound palm-leaf manuscript roll.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime model sheet of Banavasi as a personified town spirit: a lean medium-brown teen boy with an oval face, straight nose, gentle dark eyes and a calm devotional half-smile, his deep black hair tied in a small high top-knot, front fringes framing his forehead, and a thin ochre headband circling the knot with a tiny palm-leaf charm tucked in. Show him from multiple angles wearing a historically plausible early Deccan outfit: a knee-length off-white cotton dhoti with a golden-ochre border, neatly wrapped with pleats slightly to the left; a light-cream cotton shawl (uttariya) draped from his left shoulder across his chest and around his back; over this, a sleeveless dull-red cotton vest ending just above the hip, trimmed with dark-brown piping, and a narrow dark-green cloth belt tied at the side with short tassels. Give him simple leather sandals, a thin copper torque at his neck, small round copper ear-studs and a plain black-thread wrist cord, emphasizing modest sacred-town attire rather than royal finery. Place his narrow palm-leaf manuscript roll, bound with a dark-brown cord, tucked into his belt and also shown in his right hand as his constant prop. Use a palette of off-white, golden-ochre, dull red, dark green and medium brown, and keep the overall look dignified, historically grounded and suitable for consistent redraws in a shonen-style history anime.
